01 / ABOUT

Building things that work.

I'm an electronics engineer who takes projects from concept through design, fabrication, testing, and delivery. I combine electronics, controls, automation, and hands-on fabrication to solve real problems.

My background spans industrial control systems, low-voltage electronics for motorsports, electrical panel design and assembly, and personal projects in metalworking and autobody restoration. I thrive at the intersection of hardware, software, and mechanical systems—whether building electrical panels, developing data pipelines, or learning new fabrication skills.
